title: TransPhy: Visual In-Context Learning for Physically Grounded Image Editing
abstract: arXiv:2608.24119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual demonstrations provide a natural interface for specifying image transformations that are difficult to describe exhaustively with text. However, existing visual in-context learning (VICL) methods primarily focus on appearance-level relation transfer and provide limited support for physically grounded transformations, whose outcomes depend on material properties, geometry, object interactions, and environmental conditions. Given a source--target exemplar pair and a query image, physically grounded VICL requires a model to infer the demonstrated transformation, adapt its effects to the query-specific scene context, and preserve rule-irrelevant content. We introduce PhysVICL-74, comprising 74 physically grounded transformation rules and 5,240 source--target image pairs that form nearly 75K training and evaluation contexts. translated_title: TransPhy：面向物理接地图像编辑的视觉情境学习
translated_abstract: 视觉演示提供了一种自然界面，用于指定难以用文本详尽描述的图像变换。然而，现有的视觉情境学习（VICL）方法主要侧重于外观层面的关系迁移，对物理接地变换的支持有限，这类变换的结果依赖于材料属性、几何形状、物体交互和环境条件。给定一个源-目标示例对和查询图像，物理接地VICL要求模型推断演示的变换，将其效果适应于查询特定的场景上下文，并保留与规则无关的内容。我们引入了PhysVICL-74，包含74个物理接地变换规则和5,240个源-目标图像对，形成了近75K个训练和评估上下文。其基准分割分别评估了新实例迁移和未见规则泛化。我们进一步提出了...
tldr: 本文提出了PhysVICL-74数据集和TransPhy方法，首次系统性地支持物理接地图像编辑中的视觉情境学习，通过分离新实例迁移和未见规则泛化来评估模型的物理推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the PhysVICL-74 dataset and TransPhy method, systematically supporting physically grounded visual in-context learning for image editing, with separate benchmarks for novel-instance transfer and unseen-rule generalization.
